claims: NASA's Artemis II mission launched successfully on April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Kennedy Space Center.
Artemis II is a 10-day mission around the Moon.
The crew of Artemis II consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II crew is the first to travel to the Moon since 1972.
Artemis I was completed in November 2022.
Artemis I was an uncrewed test flight.
Artemis II is a crewed lunar flyby.
Artemis III is planned for mid-2027.
Artemis III is a crewed lunar landing.
Artemis IV is planned for early 2028.
The Artemis II mission includes testing of the Orion capsule's systems.
There was a noted minor issue with the space toilet shortly after the launch of Artemis II
